-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
-- users: demo (0002) shape -> POS shape, migrated IN PLACE.
-- Table swap instead of ALTER so every POS column, constraint and
-- default lands exactly as the vision schema defines them. DROP
-- before RENAME keeps notes.user_id REFERENCES users(id) pointing
-- at the name "users". db.c runs migrations with foreign_keys=OFF
-- (PRAGMA is a no-op inside the transaction), which is what makes
-- the DROP legal while notes still holds user ids. Deviations from
-- the vision: phone is NULL-able and profile_pic is kept, both for
-- demo compatibility, password_hash defaults to ''.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE users_pos (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-4' || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))),2) || '-' || substr('89ab',abs(random()) % 4 + 1, 1) || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))),2) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6)))),
    org_unit_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES org_units(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    gender INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (gender IN (1, 0, -1)), -- (1 = 'MALE', 0 = 'FEMALE', -1 = 'NON')
    username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    phone TEXT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    user_type_dict_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER' REFERENCES dictionaries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    customer_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    village_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES villages(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (status IN (1, 0, -1)), -- (1 = 'ACTIVE', 0 = 'INACTIVE', -1 = 'SUSPENDED')
    name TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (TRIM(first_name || ' ' || last_name)) VIRTUAL, -- composed read: views, fk labels, search
    profile_pic BLOB NULL, -- kept from the demo schema (superset of vision)
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
    deleted_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL
);
-- Copy demo rows (timestamps carried over). Colliding usernames/emails
-- are de-duplicated here because the POS shape enforces UNIQUE: the
-- first row by id keeps the value, later rows get '_dup<id>' in the
-- username and '+dup<id>' before the '@' in the email.
INSERT INTO users_pos (id, first_name, last_name, username, email, profile_pic, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT src.id,
       CASE WHEN instr(src.name, ' ') > 0
            THEN substr(src.name, 1, instr(src.name, ' ') - 1) ELSE src.name END,
       CASE WHEN instr(src.name, ' ') > 0
            THEN substr(src.name, instr(src.name, ' ') + 1) ELSE '' END,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM users d WHERE d.username = src.username) > 1
                 AND src.id <> (SELECT MIN(d.id) FROM users d WHERE d.username = src.username)
            THEN src.username || '_dup' || src.id ELSE src.username END,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM users d WHERE d.email = src.email) > 1
                 AND src.id <> (SELECT MIN(d.id) FROM users d WHERE d.email = src.email)
            THEN substr(src.email, 1, instr(src.email, '@')) || 'dup' || src.id || substr(src.email, instr(src.email, '@')) ELSE src.email END,
       src.profile_pic, src.created_at, src.updated_at
FROM users AS src;
DROP TABLE users;
ALTER TABLE users_pos RENAME TO users;

-- ============================================================================
-- 10. CASCADE SOFT-DELETE & RESTORE TRIGGERS
-- ============================================================================
-- One pair per master that owns child rows. Every edge here mirrors an
-- MD_ChildTab in src/pos/*.c, so soft-deleting a parent hides its children
-- (and restoring brings them back) instead of leaving orphans selectable.
--
-- The two self-referencing masters (org_units.parent_id,
-- categories.parent_id) walk their WHOLE subtree with WITH RECURSIVE: a
-- plain "UPDATE parent SET ... WHERE parent_id = OLD.id" only reaches the
-- first level, because SQLite never re-fires the trigger that is already
-- running (recursive_triggers is off) - grandchildren would stay live.
--
-- The restore side matches children on deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at, i.e.
-- "put back only what MY delete stamped": a child deleted earlier by hand
-- keeps its own timestamp and is not resurrected by its parent.
--
-- notes (0001) has no deleted_at column at all, so the users -> notes edge
-- cannot cascade and is intentionally absent.

-- ORG UNIT SOFT DELETE -> CASCADE DOWN THE WHOLE SUBTREE (self-ref) TO
-- USERS, STAFF, STOCKS
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_soft_del_org_units
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON org_units
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE org_units SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at
     WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
    UPDATE users SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at
     WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND org_unit_id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
    UPDATE staff SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at
     WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND org_unit_id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
    UPDATE inventory_stocks SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at
     WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND org_unit_id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
END;

-- ORG UNIT RESTORE -> CASCADE RESTORE DOWN THE SUBTREE
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_restore_org_units
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON org_units
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE org_units SET deleted_at = NULL
     WHERE deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at AND id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
    UPDATE users SET deleted_at = NULL
     WHERE deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at AND org_unit_id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
    UPDATE staff SET deleted_at = NULL
     WHERE deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at AND org_unit_id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
    UPDATE inventory_stocks SET deleted_at = NULL
     WHERE deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at AND org_unit_id IN (
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT id FROM org_units WHERE id = OLD.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT o.id FROM org_units o JOIN sub s ON o.parent_id = s.id
        ) SELECT id FROM sub);
END;

-- USER SOFT DELETE -> CASCADE TO USER_ROLES, ALERTS, INTERACTIONS
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_soft_del_users
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON users
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE user_roles SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at WHERE user_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    UPDATE system_alerts SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at WHERE user_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    UPDATE customer_interactions SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at WHERE user_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
END;

BEGIN
    UPDATE role_permissions SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE role_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at;
    UPDATE user_roles SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE role_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at;
END;

-- STAFF SOFT DELETE -> CASCADE TO CASH
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_soft_del_staff
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON staff
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE cash SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at WHERE staff_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
END;

-- STAFF RESTORE -> CASCADE RESTORE
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_restore_staff
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON staff
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE cash SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE staff_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at;
END;

-- INVENTORY STOCK SOFT DELETE -> CASCADE TO STOCK_LEDGER
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_soft_del_stock_ledger
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON inventory_stocks
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE stock_ledger SET deleted_at = NEW.deleted_at WHERE stock_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
END;

-- INVENTORY STOCK RESTORE -> CASCADE RESTORE
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_restore_stock_ledger
AFTER UPDATE OF deleted_at ON inventory_stocks
WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.deleted_at IS NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE stock_ledger SET deleted_at = NULL WHERE stock_id = OLD.id AND deleted_at = OLD.deleted_at;
END;

-- ============================================================================
-- 11. ACTIVE VIEWS & FINANCIAL REPORTING VIEW
-- ============================================================================

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_active_users AS 
SELECT * FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_active_products AS 
SELECT * FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_active_orders AS 
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

-- Comprehensive POS & Delivery Financial Report View.
-- Fixed vs the raw vision file: customers has no name column (person
-- names live in users.customer_id) and payment sums use a derived
-- table, so no GROUP BY over bare columns is needed.
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_pos_sales_delivery_report AS
SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.order_number,
    o.created_at AS order_date,
    ou.ou_name AS branch_name,
    cu.name AS customer_name,
    su.name AS cashier_name,
    o.subtotal,
    o.discount_amount,
    o.tax_amount,
    o.delivery_fee,
    o.total_amount,
    d.delivery_status,
    d.delivery_cost AS driver_payout_cost,
    (o.delivery_fee - IFNULL(d.delivery_cost, 0.0)) AS delivery_net_margin,
    IFNULL(p.paid, 0.0) AS total_paid
FROM orders o
JOIN org_units ou ON o.org_unit_id = ou.id
JOIN staff st ON o.staff_id = st.id
JOIN users su ON su.id = st.user_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, MIN(name) AS name FROM users
           WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
           GROUP BY customer_id) cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.id = d.order_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS paid FROM payments
           WHERE payment_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
           GROUP BY order_id) p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS v_geo_hierarchy AS
SELECT 
    v.id AS id,
    v.vill_id AS village_code,
    v.name_kh AS village_name,
    c.name_kh AS commune_name,
    d.name_kh AS district_name,
    p.name_kh AS province_name,
    v.deleted_at AS deleted_at,
    v.created_at AS created_at
FROM villages v
JOIN communes c ON v.commune_id = c.id
JOIN districts d ON c.district_id = d.id
JOIN provinces p ON d.province_id = p.id;

    <script>
    (function () {
        var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('[data-md-qbox]');
        if (!boxes.length) return;
        var f = document.getElementById('md-query-form');
        var timer;
        function kick() {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = setTimeout(function () { f.submit(); }, 400);
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < boxes.length; ++i) {
            boxes[i].addEventListener('input', kick);
            boxes[i].addEventListener('change', kick);
        }
        for (var j = 0; j < boxes.length; ++j) {
            if (boxes[j].value) {
                boxes[j].focus();
                if (boxes[j].tagName === 'INPUT') {
                    boxes[j].setSelectionRange(boxes[j].value.length,
                                               boxes[j].value.length);
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    })();
    </script>

<c> 
    // Emits one server-rendered pager per page inside <template> blocks for
    // ?fragment=all responses (js/PaginationSwitcher.js swaps the matching
    // one in when a page link is clicked). Expects the same scope as
    // pagination.h.tt plus a `fragment` flag.
    if (fragment) {
        for (size_t pgt = 1; pgt <= page_info.total_pages; ++pgt) {
            page_info.page = pgt;
            STR(temp_sprintf("<template data-pg-pager=\"%s\" data-pg-n=\"%zu\">",
                             page_container, pgt));
            #include "build/h_to_html/component/pagination.h"
            STR("</template>");
        }
    }
</c>

<c>
    // Global pager markup (included from every paged list).
    // Scope contract at each include site:
    //   Page_Info page_info;      current window (page/per_page/total/total_pages)
    //   const char *page_base;    list path, e.g. "/users"
    //   const char *page_key;     query key carrying the page ("page", "notes_page")
    //   const char *page_container;  tbody id the JS swap targets
    //   String_View page_query;   sc->query_string (keeps user_id, redirect, ...)
    // Every page link is a plain <a href> (no-JS SSR navigation) carrying
    // data-pg-n so PaginationSwitcher.js can serve it from its store;
    // per-page links carry NO data-pg-n -> always a full SSR reload.
    // The bar renders even for a single page (row count + per-page
    // switcher); Prev/Next become disabled spans at the ends.
</c>
<nav class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm"
     data-pg-container="<c> STR(page_container); </c>"
     data-pg-key="<c> STR(page_key); </c>"
     data-pg-base="<c> STR(page_base); </c>"
     data-pg-per="<c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", page_info.per_page)); </c>">
    <span class="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
        Showing <c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", (page_info.page - 1) * page_info.per_page + 1)); </c>
        &ndash;<c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", page_info.page * page_info.per_page < page_info.total
                    ? page_info.page * page_info.per_page : page_info.total)); </c>
        of <c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", page_info.total)); </c> rows
    </span>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
        <c> const char *pg_btn = "px-2 py-1 border border-gray-300 dark:border-gray-600 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700"; </c>
        <c> const char *pg_cur = "px-2 py-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white"; </c>
        <c> if (page_info.page > 1) { </c>
        <a class="<c> STR(pg_btn); </c>"
           data-pg-n="<c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", page_info.page - 1)); </c>"
           href="<c> page_href(sb, page_base, page_query, page_key, page_info.page - 1, page_info.per_page); </c>">Prev</a>
        <c> } else { </c>
        <span class="<c> STR(pg_btn); </c> opacity-40">Prev</span>
        <c> } </c>
        <c> 
            // a window of up to 5 page numbers around the current page
            size_t pg_first = page_info.page > 3 ? page_info.page - 2 : 1;
            if (pg_first + 4 > page_info.total_pages) {
                pg_first = page_info.total_pages > 4 ? page_info.total_pages - 4 : 1;

            <c> } else { </c>
            <a class="<c> STR(pg_btn); </c>"
               data-pg-n="<c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", pgn)); </c>"
               href="<c> page_href(sb, page_base, page_query, page_key, pgn, page_info.per_page); </c>"><c> STR(temp_sprintf("%zu", pgn)); </c></a>
            <c> } </c>

FILE: display/component/sweet-alert-actions.h.tt

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>
<script>
    document.addEventListener('livewire:initialized', () => {

        Livewire.on('swal:multi-action', (data) => {
            const payload = data[0];

            Swal.fire({
                title: payload.title,
                text: payload.text,
                icon: 'warning',
                showCancelButton: true,
                showDenyButton: true, // Always show 3 buttons

                confirmButtonText: payload.confirmText,
                denyButtonText: payload.denyText,
                cancelButtonText: 'Cancel',

                confirmButtonColor: payload.confirmColor || '#f59e0b', // Default Orange (Trash)
                denyButtonColor: '#ef4444', // Red (Force Delete)

            }).then((result) => {
                if (result.isConfirmed) {
                    // Button 1 Clicked (Trash OR Restore)
                    Livewire.dispatch('executeAction', {
                        id: payload.id,
                        action: payload.confirmAction
                    });
                } else if (result.isDenied) {
                    // Button 2 Clicked (Force Delete)
                    Livewire.dispatch('executeAction', {
                        id: payload.id,
                        action: payload.denyAction
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        // Standard Success Listener
        Livewire.on('swal:success', (data) => {
            Swal.fire({
                title: 'Success!',
                text: data[0].message,
                icon: 'success',
                timer: 2000,
                showConfirmButton: false
            });
        });
    });
</script>

#define sizeof_nav_perm  (sizeof(nav_perms) / sizeof(nav_perms[0]))
#define sizeof_nav_items (sizeof(nav_items) / sizeof(nav_items[0]))

    _Static_assert((sizeof_nav_perm == sizeof_nav_items),
                   "nav_perms must mirror nav_items");
    bool nav_vis[sizeof(nav_items) / sizeof(nav_items[0])];
    bool nav_grp[sizeof(nav_items) / sizeof(nav_items[0])];
    const Auth_User *nav_au = auth_current_user();
    for (size_t nv = 0; nv < nav_items_count; ++nv) {
        nav_vis[nv] = nav_au == NULL || nav_perms[nv] == NULL
            || auth_has_perm(nav_perms[nv]);
    }
    for (size_t nv = 0; nv < nav_items_count; ++nv) {
        nav_grp[nv] = false;
        if (nav_items[nv].group == NULL) continue;
        for (size_t j = nv; j < nav_items_count; ++j) {
            if (j > nv && nav_items[j].group != NULL) break;
            if (nav_vis[j]) { nav_grp[nv] = true; break; }
        }
    }

FILE: display/component/sweet-alert.h.tt

<!-- 1. Load the Library -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>

<!-- 2. Logic -->
<script>
    document.addEventListener('livewire:initialized', () => {
        
        // Helper: Check if Dark Mode is active
        const isDarkMode = () => {
            return document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') 
            || (window.matchMedia 
            && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
        };

        // Helper: Get Base Config with Dynamic Colors
        const getSwalConfig = () => {
            const dark = isDarkMode();
            return {
                background: dark ? '#1f2937' : '#ffffff', // gray-800 vs white
                color: dark ? '#f3f4f6' : '#1f2937',      // gray-100 vs gray-800
                confirmButtonColor: '#4f46e5',            // indigo-600
                cancelButtonColor: dark ? '#4b5563' : '#9ca3af', // gray-600 vs gray-400
            };
        };

        Livewire.on('swal:success', (data) => {
            Swal.fire({
                ...getSwalConfig(),
                title: 'Success!',
                text: data[0].message,
                icon: 'success',
            });
        });

        Livewire.on('swal:error', (data) => {
            Swal.fire({
                ...getSwalConfig(),
                title: 'Error!',
                text: data[0].message,
                icon: 'error',
                confirmButtonColor: '#ef4444' // Red override
            });
        });

        Livewire.on('swal:confirm', (eventData) => {
            const data = eventData[0]; 
            const config = getSwalConfig();

            Swal.fire({
                ...config,
                title: data.title,
                text: data.text,
                icon: data.icon || 'warning',
                
                showCancelButton: true,
                
                // Allow PHP to override text
                confirmButtonText: data.confirmButtonText || 'Yes, proceed!',
                cancelButtonText: data.cancelButtonText || 'Cancel',

                // Allow PHP to override colors
                confirmButtonColor: data.confirmButtonColor || config.confirmButtonColor,
                cancelButtonColor: data.cancelButtonColor || '#ef4444', 
            }).then((result) => {
                if (result.isConfirmed) {
                    Livewire.dispatch(data.method); 
                }
            });
        });
    });
</script>

    <script>window.SALE_UNITS=<c> STR(units.items ? units.items : "[]"); </c>;</script>
    <script>(
        function(){
            var U=window.SALE_UNITS||[]; function g(i){
                return document.getElementById(i);
            }
            function fmt(n){return (Math.round(n*100)/100).toFixed(2);}
            // the four nullable facets: DOM id,
            // filter key,
            //     the unit fields it reads
            var F=[
                {id:'sale-cat',k:'cat',fs:['cat'],all:'All categories'},
                {id:'sale-type',k:'type',fs:['type'],all:'All types'},
                {id:'sale-sku',k:'sku',fs:['sku','psku'],all:'All SKUs'},
                {id:'sale-bar',k:'bar',fs:['barcode'],all:'All barcodes'}
            ];
            function sel() {
                var kv={};
                F.forEach(function(f) { kv[f.k] = g(f.id).value; });
                return kv;
            }
            function hit(u, f, v){
                for(var j = 0; j < f.fs.length; j++) {
                    if(u[f.fs[j]] === v) return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            // a unit passes every selected facet except the one named in `skip`
            function pass(u,kv,skip){
                for(var i=0;i<F.length;i++){
                    var f=F[i];
                    if(f.k===skip)continue;
                    var v=kv[f.k];
                    if(v&&!hit(u,f,v))return false;
                }
                return true;
            }
            // the values a facet may offer right now: what the units matching all the
            // OTHER selected facets carry. Because a facet is never checked against its
            // own options,
            // the set is never empty and no two facets can cancel each
            // other out - the chain reaction stays consistent at every step.
            function opts(f, kv) {
                var seen={}, out=[];
                U.forEach(function(u) {
                    if(!pass(u, kv, f.k)) return;
                    for(var j = 0; j < f.fs.length; j++) {
                        var v = u[f.fs[j]] || '';
                        if(v && !seen[v]) { seen[v] = 1; out.push(v); }
                    }
                });
                out.sort();
                return out;
            }
            function fill(f,vals){
                var s=g(f.id),keep=s.value;
                while(s.firstChild)s.removeChild(s.firstChild);
                var a=document.createElement('option');a.value='';a.textContent=f.all;
                s.appendChild(a);
                vals.forEach(function(v){
                    var o=document.createElement('option');
                    o.value=v;o.textContent=v;s.appendChild(o);
                });
                if(keep){s.value=keep;if(!s.value)s.value='';}
            }
            // chain reaction: one facet changed -> re-derive EVERY facet's options
            // (each against the other facets' current selections),
            // then rebuild the list
            function refresh(){
                F.forEach(function(f) { fill(f,opts(f,sel())); });
            }
            var prod=g('sale-product'),
                priceEl=g('sale-price');
            // price is read-only text: mirror the picked unit's price
            function showPrice(){
                var o=prod.options[prod.selectedIndex];
                priceEl.textContent=(o&&o.value)?o.getAttribute('data-price'):'-';
            }
            function rebuild(){
                var kv=sel(),prev=prod.value;
                while(prod.firstChild)prod.removeChild(prod.firstChild);
                var b=document.createElement('option');b.value='';
                b.textContent='Select product...';prod.appendChild(b);
                U.forEach(function(u){if(!pass(u,kv,null))return;
                    var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=u.key;
                    o.textContent=u.name+' - '+(u.sku||u.psku||'');
                    o.setAttribute('data-price',fmt(u.price));
                    prod.appendChild(o);
                });
                if(prev){
                    prod.value=prev;
                    if(prod.value!==prev)prod.value='';
                }
                showPrice();}
            function onFilter(){refresh();rebuild();}
            F.forEach(function(f){ g(f.id).addEventListener('change',onFilter); });
            prod.addEventListener('change',showPrice);
            var lines=g('sale-lines'),totalEl=g('sale-total'),seq=0;
            function recalc(){
                var t=0;
                lines.querySelectorAll('[data-line]').forEach(function(r) {
                    t+=parseFloat(r.getAttribute('data-total'))||0;
                });
                totalEl.textContent=fmt(t);
            }
            // add the picked unit + qty as a posted line, then reset
            function add(){
                var o=prod.options[prod.selectedIndex];
                if(!o||!o.value)return;
                var key=o.value,label=o.textContent,
                    pr=parseFloat(o.getAttribute('data-price'))||0;
                var q=parseInt(g('sale-qty').value,10);
                if(!(q>0))q=1;
                var i=seq++,row=document.createElement('div');
                row.setAttribute('data-line','');
                row.setAttribute('data-total',fmt(pr*q));
                row.className='flex items-center gap-2 text-sm border-t border-surface0 pt-2';
                var hi=document.createElement('input');hi.type='hidden';
                hi.name='line'+i+'_item';hi.value=key;row.appendChild(hi);
                var hq=document.createElement('input');hq.type='hidden';
                hq.name='line'+i+'_qty';hq.value=String(q);row.appendChild(hq);
                var nm=document.createElement('div');
                nm.className='flex-1 min-w-0 truncate';
                nm.textContent=label;row.appendChild(nm);
                var pc=document.createElement('div');
                pc.className='w-20 text-right text-subtext0';
                pc.textContent=fmt(pr);row.appendChild(pc);
                var qc=document.createElement('div');
                qc.className='w-10 text-right';qc.textContent='x'+q;row.appendChild(qc);
                var tt=document.createElement('div');
                tt.className='w-24 text-right font-mono';
                tt.textContent=fmt(pr*q);row.appendChild(tt);
                var rm=document.createElement('button');rm.type='button';
                rm.setAttribute('data-rm','');rm.className='text-red px-1';
                rm.textContent='\u2715';row.appendChild(rm);
                lines.appendChild(row);prod.value='';showPrice();
                g('sale-qty').value='1';recalc();
            }
            g('sale-add').addEventListener('click',add);
            lines.addEventListener('click',function(e){
                if(e.target.hasAttribute&&e.target.hasAttribute('data-rm')){
                    var r=e.target.closest('[data-line]');if(r){r.remove();recalc();}
                }
            });
            refresh();
            rebuild();
        })();
    </script>

FILE: js/ListExpandSwitcher.js

// master_child UI controller (vanilla JS, no framework).
//
// Every row/panel handler is event-DELEGATED on `document`, so HTML hot
// swapped in by the fetch submit path (#mc-root) keeps working with no
// re-initialization and no double-binding.
//
// CRUD flow (both phases):
//   1. submit -> snapshot the visible data-row-id values into sessionStorage
//      (MD_FLASH_KEY). Ids are random uuids and row order is NOT insertion
//      order, so the diff is the only exact way to find the new row later.
//   2. fetch  -> POST the form; the browser invisibly follows the server's
//      normal 302 PRG (server and no-JS behavior unchanged).
//   3. swap   -> parse the final page, replace #mc-root, restore open
//      panels/active tabs, then reveal: reopen the scope, diff the ids and
//      flash the exact new/edited row.
//   Fallback  -> network failure: native submit (reveal runs after the
//      redirect); HTTP error: inline banner, input kept, flash dropped.

const MD_FLASH_KEY = 'md-flash';

// Quote a value for use inside an attribute selector (ids are uuid/numeric,
// this is just belt and braces).
function mdSel(value) {
    return String(value).replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/"/g, '\\"');
}

function mdChildRows(scope, masterId) {
    if (!scope || !masterId) return null;
    const content = document.querySelector(
        '.tab-content[data-tab="' + mdSel(scope) + '"][data-master-id="' + mdSel(masterId) + '"]');
    // Scope to the id'd tbody: after a master-page flip a cluster may carry
    // a nested pagination store (tbody without id) whose rows must not be
    // counted here.
    return content ? Array.from(content.querySelectorAll('tbody[id] > tr[data-row-id]')) : null;
}

function mdMasterRows() {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.master-table tbody > tr[data-row-id]'));
}

function mdSnapshot(form) {
    const d = form.dataset;
    const snap = {
        kind: d.mdKind || 'master',
        scope: d.mdScope || '',
        op: d.mdOp || '',
        master: d.mdMaster || '',
        target: d.mdTarget || '',
        masterIds: [],
        childIds: [],
    };
    mdMasterRows().forEach(tr => snap.masterIds.push(tr.dataset.rowId));
    if (snap.kind === 'child') {
        const rows = mdChildRows(snap.scope, snap.master);
        if (rows) rows.forEach(tr => snap.childIds.push(tr.dataset.rowId));
    }
    return snap;
}

function mdFlash(el) {
    try { el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }); }
    catch (e) { el.scrollIntoView(); }
    el.style.transition = 'background-color 900ms ease';
    el.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45)';
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0)'; }, 500);
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.transition = ''; el.style.backgroundColor = ''; }, 1600);
}

// Consume a pending flash snapshot (runs on page load for the native
// redirect path, and after every fetch swap).
function mdReveal() {
    let raw = null;
    try { raw = sessionStorage.getItem(MD_FLASH_KEY); }
    catch (e) { return; }
    if (!raw) return;
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(MD_FLASH_KEY); }
    catch (e) {}
    let snap;
    try { snap = JSON.parse(raw); }
    catch (e) { return; }

    let row = null;
    if (snap.kind === 'child') {
        if (snap.master) {
            const expand = document.querySelector(
                '.expand-btn[data-master-id="' + mdSel(snap.master) + '"]');
            if (expand && expand.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') expand.click();
            const tabBtn = document.querySelector(
                '.detail-panel-row[data-master-id="' + mdSel(snap.master) + '"]' +
                ' .tab-btn[data-tab="' + mdSel(snap.scope) + '"]');
            if (tabBtn) tabBtn.click();
        }
        const rows = mdChildRows(snap.scope, snap.master);
        if (snap.op === 'create' && rows) {
            const before = new Set(snap.childIds || []);
            row = rows.find(tr => !before.has(tr.dataset.rowId)) || null;
        } else if (snap.op === 'update' && snap.target && rows) {
            row = rows.find(tr => tr.dataset.rowId === snap.target) || null;
        }
    } else {
        if (snap.op === 'create') {
            const before = new Set(snap.masterIds || []);
            row = mdMasterRows().find(tr => !before.has(tr.dataset.rowId)) || null;
        } else if (snap.op === 'update' && snap.target) {
            row = document.querySelector(
                '.master-table tbody > tr[data-row-id="' + mdSel(snap.target) + '"]');
        }
    }
    if (row) mdFlash(row);
}

// Swap #mc-root for freshly rendered HTML, restoring which master panels
// were open and which child tab was active, then reveal.
function mdSwap(newRoot) {
    const openIds = [];
    document.querySelectorAll('.expand-btn[aria-expanded="true"]')
        .forEach(b => openIds.push(b.dataset.masterId));
    const activeTabs = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('.detail-panel-row').forEach(r => {
        const active = r.querySelector('.tab-content:not(.hidden)');
        if (active && r.dataset.masterId) {
            activeTabs[r.dataset.masterId] = active.dataset.tab;
        }
    });

    const root = document.getElementById('mc-root');
    if (!root) return false;
    root.replaceWith(document.importNode(newRoot, true));

    openIds.forEach(id => {
        const btn = document.querySelector('.expand-btn[data-master-id="' + mdSel(id) + '"]');
        if (btn && btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') btn.click();
    });
    Object.keys(activeTabs).forEach(id => {
        const tab = document.querySelector(
            '.detail-panel-row[data-master-id="' + mdSel(id) + '"]' +
            ' .tab-btn[data-tab="' + mdSel(activeTabs[id]) + '"]');
        if (tab) tab.click();
    });
    mdReveal();
    // GeoCascade re-arms on the fresh containers mdSwap just installed.
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('md:swapped'));
    return true;
}

function mdBanner(form, status, reason) {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.style.cssText = 'border:1px solid #f87171;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;' +
        'padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;' +
        'align-items:center;gap:12px;max-width:640px;';
    const msg = document.createElement('span');
    // `reason` is the server's plain-text body (e.g. the 409 duplicate
    // explanation); without it fall back to the generic status text.
    msg.textContent = (reason ||
        'Request failed' + (status ? ' (HTTP ' + status + ')' : '')) +
        ' - your input was kept.';
    const close = document.createElement('button');
    close.type = 'button';
    close.textContent = 'x';
    close.style.cssText = 'border:none;background:none;color:inherit;font-weight:bold;' +
        'cursor:pointer;padding:0 4px;';
    close.addEventListener('click', () => div.remove());
    div.appendChild(msg);
    div.appendChild(close);
    if (form.parentElement) form.parentElement.insertBefore(div, form);
}

async function mdHandleSubmit(e, form) {
    if ((form.method || 'get').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') return;
    e.preventDefault();

    // 1. snapshot ids before the DOM changes
    const snap = mdSnapshot(form);
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(MD_FLASH_KEY, JSON.stringify(snap)); } catch (err) {}

    // 2. disable confirm buttons while in flight (no double POST)
    const busy = [];
    if (form.id) {
        document.querySelectorAll('button[form="' + form.id + '"]')
            .forEach(b => busy.push(b));
    }
    form.querySelectorAll('button[type="submit"]').forEach(b => {
        if (!busy.includes(b)) busy.push(b);
    });
    busy.forEach(b => { b.disabled = true; });

    try {
        // 3. POST via fetch; browser follows the server's normal 302 PRG
        let res;
        try {
            res = await fetch(form.action, {
                method: 'POST',
                body: new FormData(form),
                cache: 'no-store', // never swap in a cached page
            });
        } catch (err) {
            form.submit(); // native PRG; mdReveal() runs after the redirect
            return;
        }

        if (res.ok) {
            let newRoot = null;
            try {
                const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await res.text(), 'text/html');
                newRoot = doc.querySelector('#mc-root');
            } catch (err) {}
            if (newRoot && mdSwap(newRoot)) {
                // content came from the redirect target: sync the address bar
                // to it (drop stale ?page state) and refresh the pagination
                // store for the swapped DOM
                try {
                    if (res.url && window.history.replaceState) {
                        history.replaceState(null, '', res.url);
                    }
                } catch (err) {}
                if (window.pgReset) window.pgReset();
                if (window.pgArm) window.pgArm();
                return;
            }
            // redirect landed outside the component: full navigation
            try { sessionStorage.removeItem(MD_FLASH_KEY); } catch (err) {}
            window.location.assign(res.url || form.action);
            return;
        }

        // HTTP error (400/409/413/500): keep the input, drop the pending
        // flash. A plain-text body (the 409 duplicate reason) replaces the
        // generic banner text; styled HTML error pages keep the default.
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem(MD_FLASH_KEY); } catch (err) {}
        let reason = '';
        try {
            const ctype = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
            if (ctype.startsWith('text/plain'))
                reason = (await res.text()).trim();
        } catch (err) { /* body gone -> generic text */ }
        mdBanner(form, res.status, reason);
    } finally {
        busy.forEach(b => { b.disabled = false; });
    }
}

window.masterDetailController = {
    initialized: false,

    init() {
        if (this.initialized) return;
        this.initialized = true;
        const EYE_OPEN = `
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                          <path d="M2 12s3-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3 7-10 7-10-7-10-7Z" />
                          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                        </svg>`;

        const EYE_CLOSE = `
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                          <path d="M10.73 5.08A10.43 10.43 0 0 1 12 5c7 0 10 7 10 7a13.16 13.16 0 0 1-1.67 2.68" />
                          <path d="M6.61 6.61A13.53 13.53 0 0 0 2 12s3 7 10 7a9.74 9.74 0 0 0 5.39-1.61" />
                          <path d="M9.88 9.88a3 3 0 1 0 4.24 4.24" />
                          <line x1="2" y1="2" x2="22" y2="22" />
                        </svg>`;
        // Expand / collapse master detail panel
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.expand-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            const id = btn.dataset.masterId;
            const panel = document.querySelector('.detail-panel-row[data-master-id="' + id + '"]');
            const open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!open));
            if (open) { 
                btn.innerHTML = EYE_OPEN;
                if (panel) {
                    panel.style.display = 'none';
                    const tbodies = panel.querySelectorAll('.tab-content tbody[id]');
                    tbodies.forEach(function (tb) {
                        tb.setAttribute('data-cached-html', tb.innerHTML);
                        tb.innerHTML = '';
                    });
                }
            } else {
                btn.innerHTML = EYE_CLOSE;
                if (panel) {
                    panel.style.display = 'table-row';
                    const tbodies = panel.querySelectorAll('.tab-content tbody[id]');
                    tbodies.forEach(function (tb) {
                        const cached = tb.getAttribute('data-cached-html');
                        if (cached) {
                            tb.innerHTML = cached;
                            tb.removeAttribute('data-cached-html');
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        });

        // Tab switching within a panel
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.tab-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            const panel = btn.closest('.detail-panel');
            if (!panel) return;
            const tab = btn.dataset.tab;
            panel.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
                const active = b === btn;
                b.classList.toggle('text-indigo-600', active);
                b.classList.toggle('border-b-2', active);
                b.classList.toggle('border-indigo-600', active);
            });
            panel.querySelectorAll(':scope > .tab-content').forEach(c =>
                c.classList.toggle('hidden', c.dataset.tab !== tab));
        });

        // + Add: reveal inline add-row (no navigation)
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.add-child-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            const content = btn.closest('.tab-content');
            const addRow = content && content.querySelector('.md-add-row');
            if (addRow) addRow.classList.toggle('hidden');
        });

        // Master inline edit: hide master row, show paired edit row
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.master-edit-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            const row = btn.closest('tr');
            const editRow = row && row.nextElementSibling;
            if (editRow && editRow.classList.contains('md-master-edit-row')) {
                row.classList.add('hidden');
                editRow.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        });

        // Edit: hide display row, show its paired edit row
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.child-edit-btn');
            if (!btn) return;
            const row = btn.closest('tr');
            const editRow = row && row.nextElementSibling;
            if (editRow && editRow.classList.contains('md-edit-row')) {
                row.classList.add('hidden');
                editRow.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        });

        // Discard: reset form, hide row, unhide display row if paired
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.md-discard');
            if (!btn) return;
            const tr = btn.closest('tr');
            if (!tr) return;
            const form = tr.querySelector('form');
            if (form) form.reset();
            tr.classList.add('hidden');
            const prev = tr.previousElementSibling;
            if (prev
                && !prev.classList.contains('md-add-row')
                && !prev.classList.contains('md-edit-row')
                && !prev.classList.contains('md-master-edit-row')) {
                prev.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        });

        // ---- auto calculations (FX 1 USD = 4000 KHR) ----
        const FX = 4000;

        // Auto Days: room_day = end_date - start_date
        document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            if (e.target.name !== 'end_date') return;
            const scope = e.target.closest('tr');
            if (!scope) return;
            const start = scope.querySelector('[name="start_date"]');
            const days = scope.querySelector('[name="room_day"]');
            if (!start || !days || !start.value || !e.target.value) return;
            const diff = (new Date(e.target.value) - new Date(start.value)) / 86400000;
            days.value = diff > 0 ? diff : '';
        });

        // amount_in_riel <-> amount_in_dollar inside same form/row
        document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const n = e.target.name;
            if (n !== 'amount_in_riel' && n !== 'amount_in_dollar') return;
            const scope = e.target.closest('tr, form');
            if (!scope) return;
            const v = parseFloat(e.target.value);
            if (isNaN(v)) return;
            const other = scope.querySelector(
                n === 'amount_in_riel' ? '[name="amount_in_dollar"]' : '[name="amount_in_riel"]');
            if (!other || other === e.target) return;
            other.value = (n === 'amount_in_riel' ? v / FX : v * FX).toFixed(2);
        });

        // amount = qty * price on detail rows
        document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const n = e.target.name;
            if (n !== 'qty' && n !== 'price') return;
            const row = e.target.closest('tr');
            if (!row) return;
            const qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('[name="qty"]')?.value);
            const price = parseFloat(row.querySelector('[name="price"]')?.value);
            const amount = row.querySelector('[name="amount"]');
            if (amount && !isNaN(qty) && !isNaN(price)) amount.value = (qty * price).toFixed(2);
        });

        // master_child CRUD forms: snapshot -> fetch -> swap -> reveal
        document.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
            const form = e.target;
            if (!form || form.tagName !== 'FORM' || !form.dataset || !form.dataset.mdScope) return;
            mdHandleSubmit(e, form).catch(err => {
                // unexpected error after the POST: never re-post, just report
                console.error('md submit failed', err);
                try { sessionStorage.removeItem(MD_FLASH_KEY); } catch (e2) {}
                mdBanner(form, 0);
            });
        });

        // consume a pending flash from a native PRG redirect (phase 1 path)
        mdReveal();
    }
};

(() => {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window.masterDetailController.init());
})();

// Photo upload controller (vanilla JS, no framework).
//
// Wires every wrapper marked [data-img-upload] that contains a file input:
//   1. img-icon button   - the raw <input type=file> is visually hidden and
//      driven by a labelled button with an image icon (label click opens
//      the native picker; no custom file-dialog code).
//   2. live preview      - the picked file appears immediately in the
//      circular frame next to the button (object-cover, avatar shaped),
//      with its name/size underneath.
//   3. compression       - modelled on chiragvaze/Image-Compressor
//      (script.js): canvas resize to max 1920px, quality 0.82,
//      canvas.toBlob -> the compressed File replaces input.files through a
//      DataTransfer, so the multipart POST carries the small bytes. GIFs
//      are skipped (compression would flatten the animation).
//   4. crop modal        - square viewport, drag to pan, zoom slider
//      (wheel also zooms). Apply draws the crop region onto a 512x512
//      canvas and again replaces input.files. The server is unchanged:
//      save_uploaded_image() still magic-byte-checks and ffmpeg-converts
//      to webp (src/http/utils.c).
//
// One lazily-built modal per input; DOM is created here so the templates
// (display/user*.tt) carry only the wrapper markup and nothing else.

const IU_CROP_SIZE = 512;  // crop output: square edge, px
const IU_CROP_QUALITY = 0.82;  // crop output: canvas.toBlob quality

// Server upload cap: MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGE_SIZE in src/http/utils.h (2 MB), minus
// a margin for the multipart envelope + the other form fields. The attempt
// list walks quality/dimensions down until the blob fits - without it a
// noisy photo at 1920px/q0.82 can exceed the cap and the POST is rejected
// server-side AFTER all this client work.
const IU_MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024 - 64 * 1024;
const IU_ATTEMPTS = [
    [1920, 0.82], [1600, 0.72], [1280, 0.62],
    [1024, 0.52], [800, 0.45], [640, 0.40],
];

function iuFmtSize(bytes) {
    if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(0) + ' KB';
    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
}

// Replace the input's files with exactly one (compressed/cropped) file.
// DataTransfer is the only way to assign to input.files from script.
function iuSetFile(input, file) {
    const dt = new DataTransfer();
    dt.items.add(file);
    input.files = dt.files;
}

// Compress `file` on a canvas. Walks IU_ATTEMPTS down until the blob is
// under the server's upload cap; resolves with a smaller File, or null when
// the original should be kept (GIF, decode failure, no size gain).
function iuCompress(file) {
    if (file.type === 'image/gif') return Promise.resolve(null);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = () => {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            const iw = img.naturalWidth, ih = img.naturalHeight;
            const png = file.type === 'image/png';
            const mime = png ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg';
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            const attempt = (i) => {
                if (i >= IU_ATTEMPTS.length) { resolve(null); return; }
                const [maxDim, quality] = IU_ATTEMPTS[i];
                const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(iw, ih));
                canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(iw * scale));
                canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(ih * scale));
                ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
                    if (!blob) { resolve(null); return; }
                    if (blob.size > IU_MAX_BYTES) { attempt(i + 1); return; }
                    // Fits - but only swap when it actually got smaller.
                    if (blob.size >= file.size) { resolve(null); return; }
                    const stem = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]*$/, '');
                    resolve(new File([blob], stem + (png ? '.png' : '.jpg'),
                                     { type: blob.type }));
                }, mime, quality);
            };
            attempt(0);
        };
        img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); resolve(null); };
        img.src = url;
    });
}

// -- crop modal -------------------------------------------------------------

function iuBuildModal(state) {
    const m = document.createElement('div');
    m.className = 'fixed inset-0 z-50 hidden';
    m.innerHTML =
        '<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60" data-iu-backdrop></div>' +
        '<div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-4 pointer-events-none">' +
        '  <div class="pointer-events-auto bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-xl w-full max-w-sm">' +
        '    <h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 dark:text-white mb-2">Crop photo</h3>' +
        '    <div data-iu-viewport class="relative overflow-hidden w-full aspect-square rounded ' +
             'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 cursor-move touch-none select-none">' +
        '      <img data-iu-img alt="" class="absolute left-0 top-0 origin-top-left max-w-none pointer-events-none" draggable="false">' +
        '    </div>' +
        '    <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 mt-2">Zoom' +
        '      <input data-iu-zoom type="range" min="100" max="400" value="100" class="flex-1">' +
        '    </label>' +
        '    <div class="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-3">' +
        '      <button type="button" data-iu-cancel class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-sm ' +
              'bg-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-600 text-white">Cancel</button>' +
        '      <button type="button" data-iu-apply class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-sm ' +
              'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white">Apply</button>' +
        '    </div>' +
        '  </div>' +
        '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(m);

    state.modal = m;
    state.viewport = m.querySelector('[data-iu-viewport]');
    state.img = m.querySelector('[data-iu-img]');
    state.zoom = m.querySelector('[data-iu-zoom]');

    m.querySelector('[data-iu-backdrop]').addEventListener('click', iuCloseModal.bind(null, state));
    m.querySelector('[data-iu-cancel]').addEventListener('click', iuCloseModal.bind(null, state));
    m.querySelector('[data-iu-apply]').addEventListener('click', () => iuApplyCrop(state));
    state.zoom.addEventListener('input', () => iuSetZoom(state, state.zoom.value / 100));

    // Drag to pan: the pointer position is tracked against the transform at
    // drag start, so a mid-drag zoom (wheel/slider) cannot jump the image.
    state.viewport.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        // drag state first, capture second: a synthetic PointerEvent (tests)
        // has no active pointer, and setPointerCapture would throw before
        // state.drag was ever set.
        state.drag = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, tx: state.tx, ty: state.ty };
        try { state.viewport.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* synthetic */ }
    });
    state.viewport.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (!state.drag) return;
        state.tx = state.drag.tx + (e.clientX - state.drag.x);
        state.ty = state.drag.ty + (e.clientY - state.drag.y);
        iuClamp(state);
        iuPaint(state);
    });
    state.viewport.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { state.drag = null; });
    state.viewport.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => { state.drag = null; });
    state.viewport.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const next = Math.min(400, Math.max(100,
            Math.round(state.zoom.value + (e.deltaY < 0 ? 10 : -10))));
        state.zoom.value = next;
        iuSetZoom(state, next / 100);
    }, { passive: false });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && !m.classList.contains('hidden')) iuCloseModal(state);
    });
    return m;
}

// Zoom is stored relative to the "cover" scale (z=1 = viewport just filled).
function iuSetZoom(state, z) {
    const s = state.cover * z;
    // Keep the point currently at the viewport centre pinned there.
    const cx = (state.vp / 2 - state.tx) / state.s;
    const cy = (state.vp / 2 - state.ty) / state.s;
    state.s = s;
    state.tx = state.vp / 2 - cx * s;
    state.ty = state.vp / 2 - cy * s;
    iuClamp(state);
    iuPaint(state);
}

// The image must always cover the square viewport (no empty edges).
function iuClamp(state) {
    const minX = state.vp - state.iw * state.s;
    const minY = state.vp - state.ih * state.s;
    state.tx = Math.min(0, Math.max(minX, state.tx));
    state.ty = Math.min(0, Math.max(minY, state.ty));
}

function iuPaint(state) {
    state.img.style.transform =
        'translate(' + state.tx + 'px,' + state.ty + 'px) scale(' + state.s + ')';
}

function iuOpenModal(state) {
    if (!state.original) return;
    const m = state.modal || iuBuildModal(state);
    state.img.onload = () => {
        // Un-hide FIRST: while the modal is display:none the viewport
        // measures 0px, cover becomes 0 and the image paints at scale(0)
        // (invisible, unzoomable, unpannable - found by img_upload_test).
        m.classList.remove('hidden');
        state.vp = state.viewport.clientWidth;
        state.iw = state.img.naturalWidth;
        state.ih = state.img.naturalHeight;
        state.cover = Math.max(state.vp / state.iw, state.vp / state.ih);
        state.zoom.value = 100;
        state.s = state.cover;
        state.tx = (state.vp - state.iw * state.s) / 2;
        state.ty = (state.vp - state.ih * state.s) / 2;
        iuClamp(state);
        iuPaint(state);
    };
    state.img.src = state.url;  // crop from the ORIGINAL, pre-compression file
}

function iuCloseModal(state) {
    if (state.modal) state.modal.classList.add('hidden');
    state.drag = null;
}

// Map the visible square back to source pixels and draw it out at
// IU_CROP_SIZE x IU_CROP_SIZE.
function iuApplyCrop(state) {
    const vp = state.viewport.clientWidth;
    const sx = -state.tx / state.s;
    const sy = -state.ty / state.s;
    const sw = vp / state.s;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = IU_CROP_SIZE;
    canvas.height = IU_CROP_SIZE;
    canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(
        state.img, sx, sy, sw, sw, 0, 0, IU_CROP_SIZE, IU_CROP_SIZE);
    const png = state.original.type === 'image/png';
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
        if (!blob) { iuCloseModal(state); return; }
        const stem = state.original.name.replace(/\.[^.]*$/, '');
        const file = new File([blob], stem + (png ? '.png' : '.jpg'),
                              { type: blob.type });
        iuSetFile(state.input, file);
        iuShowPreview(state, URL.createObjectURL(blob));
        state.nameEl.textContent =
            file.name + ' · cropped ' + iuFmtSize(file.size);
        iuCloseModal(state);
    }, png ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg', IU_CROP_QUALITY);
}

// -- per-wrapper wiring -----------------------------------------------------

function iuShowPreview(state, url) {
    if (state.url && state.url !== url && state.url.startsWith('blob:')) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(state.url);
    }
    state.url = url;
    state.preview.src = url;
    state.preview.classList.remove('hidden');
    state.placeholder.classList.add('hidden');
}

function iuReset(state) {
    if (state.url && state.url !== url && state.url.startsWith('blob:')) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(state.url);
    }
    state.url = null;
    state.original = null;
    state.preview.removeAttribute('src');
    state.preview.classList.add('hidden');
    state.placeholder.classList.remove('hidden');
    state.cropBtn.classList.add('hidden');
    state.nameEl.textContent = 'no file selected';
}

function iuOnSelect(state) {
    const file = state.input.files && state.input.files[0];
    if (!file) { iuReset(state); return; }

    const seq = ++state.seq;
    state.original = file;
    iuShowPreview(state, URL.createObjectURL(file));
    state.nameEl.textContent = file.name + ' · ' + iuFmtSize(file.size);

    if (file.type === 'image/gif') {
        // Animated: compression/cropping would freeze it on one frame.
        state.cropBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        state.nameEl.textContent += ' (animated, kept as-is)';
        return;
    }
    state.cropBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

    iuCompress(file).then((small) => {
        // A newer selection may have landed while the canvas worked.
        if (!small || seq !== state.seq || !state.input.files[0]) return;
        iuSetFile(state.input, small);
        state.nameEl.textContent =
            file.name + ' · ' + iuFmtSize(file.size) +
            ' → ' + iuFmtSize(small.size);
    });
}

function iuWire(wrapper) {
    if (wrapper.dataset.iuReady) return;
    const input = wrapper.querySelector('input[type="file"]');
    if (!input) return;
    wrapper.dataset.iuReady = '1';

    const state = {
        input,
        wrapper,
        preview: wrapper.querySelector('[data-img-preview]'),
        placeholder: wrapper.querySelector('[data-img-placeholder]'),
        cropBtn: wrapper.querySelector('[data-img-crop]'),
        nameEl: wrapper.querySelector('[data-img-name]'),
        modal: null, viewport: null, img: null, zoom: null,
        url: null, original: null, seq: 0,
        tx: 0, ty: 0, s: 1, cover: 1, vp: 1, iw: 1, ih: 1, drag: null,
    };
    if (!state.preview || !state.cropBtn || !state.nameEl) return;

    const existingSrc = state.preview.getAttribute('src');
    if (existingSrc && existingSrc.trim() !== '') {
        state.url = existingSrc;
        state.preview.classList.remove("hidden");
        if (state.placeholder) state.placeholder.classList.add("hidden");
        if (state.nameEl.textContent.trim() === 'no file selected' ||
            state.nameEl.textContent.trim() === 'no file') {
            state.nameEl.textContent = 'current photo';
        }
    }

    input.addEventListener('change', () => iuOnSelect(state));
    state.cropBtn.addEventListener('click', () => iuOpenModal(state));
}

function iuInit() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-img-upload]').forEach(iuWire);
}

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', iuInit);
} else {
    iuInit();
}
document.addEventListener('md:swapped', iuInit);

FILE: js/GeoCascade.js
=====================================================

// GeoCascade: province -> district -> commune -> village picker (vanilla JS).
//
// The three ancestors are embedded once per page as inert JSON in
// <script type="application/json" data-geo-data>, shaped as
//   { "p": [[id, "", name_kh], ...],            (provinces, no parent)
//     "d": [[id, province_id, name_kh], ...],   (districts)
//     "c": [[id, district_id, name_kh], ...],   (communes)
//     "s": { village_id: commune_id, ... } }    (villages chosen on THIS page)
// so province/district/commune filtering is pure array work - zero
// round-trips. Only villages (14,858 of them, ~870 KB as one <select>)
// are fetched, and only for the single commune the user picked:
// GET /geo/villages?commune=<id> answers bare <option> lines.
//
// The three ancestor selects are UI-ONLY navigation: they carry no `name`
// attribute, so the form still posts exactly one field, village_id.
//
// Every handler is document-delegated and re-runs on init(), because
// ListExpandSwitcher's mdSwap() replaces #mc-root wholesale after a
// fetch submit.

(() => {
    'use strict';

    const LEVELS = ['province', 'district', 'commune', 'village'];
    // Which embedded array feeds each nav level, and which tuple slot of
    // that array's rows holds the parent id. 'village' is not here: it is
    // fetched, not embedded.
    const PARENT_SLOT = { d: 1, c: 1 };
    const PLACEHOLDER = {
        province: 'Select Province',
        district: 'Select District',
        commune:  'Select Commune',
        village:  'Select Village',
    };

    let DATA = null;   // parsed dataset, or null when absent/unparseable

    function readDataset() {
        const el = document.querySelector('script[data-geo-data]');
        if (!el) { DATA = null; return; }
        try { DATA = JSON.parse(el.textContent); }
        catch (e) { DATA = null; console.warn('GeoCascade: bad dataset', e); }
    }

    // Index an array of [id, parent, name] rows by their parent id, so a
    // province's districts are one Map lookup instead of a 1,712-row scan.
    // Cached per array; the dataset never changes within a page.
    let byParent = null;
    function indexRows(arrKey) {
        if (byParent && byParent[arrKey]) return byParent[arrKey];
        const map = new Map();
        const rows = (DATA && DATA[arrKey]) || [];
        const slot = PARENT_SLOT[arrKey];
        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; ++i) {
            const p = rows[i][slot];
            let bucket = map.get(p);
            if (!bucket) { bucket = []; map.set(p, bucket); }
            bucket.push(rows[i]);
        }
        if (!byParent) byParent = {};
        byParent[arrKey] = map;
        return map;
    }

    // Rows of `arrKey` whose parent equals `parentId`. parentId === null
    // means "top level" (provinces, whose tuple slot 1 is "").
    function rowsFor(arrKey, parentId) {
        if (!DATA) return [];
        if (parentId === null || parentId === undefined || parentId === '') {
            return DATA[arrKey] || [];
        }
        return indexRows(arrKey).get(parentId) || [];
    }

    function levelEl(box, level) { return box.querySelector('[data-geo="' + level + '"]'); }

    // Replace a select's options, selecting `keep` when it is present.
    function fill(sel, rows, keep) {
        const keepValue = keep || '';
        sel.textContent = '';
        const ph = document.createElement('option');
        ph.value = '';
        ph.textContent = PLACEHOLDER[sel.dataset.geo] || '';
        sel.appendChild(ph);
        for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; ++i) {
            const o = document.createElement('option');
            o.value = rows[i][0];
            o.textContent = rows[i][2];
            if (rows[i][0] === keepValue) o.selected = true;
            sel.appendChild(o);
        }
    }

    function setEnabled(sel, on) { if (sel) sel.disabled = !on; }

    // ---- lazy village half -------------------------------------------------
    const villageCache = new Map();   // commune_id -> option HTML ('' on failure)

    function applyVillageOptions(sel, html, keep) {
        const prev = keep || '';
        sel.textContent = '';
        const ph = document.createElement('option');
        ph.value = '';
        ph.textContent = PLACEHOLDER.village;
        sel.appendChild(ph);
        if (html) {
            // The endpoint answers trusted server-rendered <option> lines.
            const tpl = document.createElement('template');
            tpl.innerHTML = html;
            const opts = tpl.content.querySelectorAll('option');
            for (let i = 0; i < opts.length; ++i) sel.appendChild(opts[i]);
        }
        // A stored village outside the fetched set must still win, or the
        // form would silently re-point the FK on submit.
        if (prev) {
            let has = false;
            for (let i = 0; i < sel.options.length; ++i) {
                if (sel.options[i].value === prev) { sel.options[i].selected = true; has = true; break; }
            }
            if (!has) {
                const o = document.createElement('option');
                o.value = prev; o.textContent = prev; o.selected = true;
                sel.appendChild(o);
            }
        }
        setEnabled(sel, true);
    }

    function loadVillages(box, communeId, keep) {
        const sel = levelEl(box, 'village');
        if (!sel) return;
        if (!communeId) { applyVillageOptions(sel, '', keep); return; }
        const cached = villageCache.get(communeId);
        if (cached !== undefined) { applyVillageOptions(sel, cached, keep); return; }
        fetch('/geo/villages?commune=' + encodeURIComponent(communeId), {
            cache: 'no-store',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
        })
            .then(r => (r.ok ? r.text() : ''))
            .then(html => {
                villageCache.set(communeId, html);
                // The user may have moved on while the request was in flight.
                if (levelEl(box, 'commune').value === communeId) {
                    applyVillageOptions(sel, html, keep);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => { villageCache.set(communeId, ''); });
    }

    // ---- cascade wiring ----------------------------------------------------
    function clearBelow(box, fromIdx) {
        for (let i = fromIdx; i < LEVELS.length; ++i) {
            const sel = levelEl(box, LEVELS[i]);
            if (!sel) continue;
            if (LEVELS[i] === 'village') { applyVillageOptions(sel, '', ''); }
            else { fill(sel, [], ''); setEnabled(sel, false); }
        }
    }

    function onAncestorChange(box, level) {
        const idx = LEVELS.indexOf(level);
        const val = levelEl(box, level).value;
        clearBelow(box, idx + 1);

        if (level === 'province') {
            const d = levelEl(box, 'district');
            fill(d, rowsFor('d', val), '');
            setEnabled(d, !!val);
        } else if (level === 'district') {
            const c = levelEl(box, 'commune');
            fill(c, rowsFor('c', val), '');
            setEnabled(c, !!val);
        } else if (level === 'commune') {
            loadVillages(box, val, '');
        }
    }

    // Walk a stored village back up: s[village] -> commune -> district ->
    // province, filling and selecting each level so the edit form shows
    // where the row already lives instead of three empty nav selects.
    function restore(box) {
        const village = levelEl(box, 'village');
        if (!village || !DATA) return;
        const stored = village.value;
        const p = levelEl(box, 'province');
        const d = levelEl(box, 'district');
        const c = levelEl(box, 'commune');

        if (!stored) {
            // CREATE form, or a row whose village_id is NULL: there is
            // nothing to walk back up from. But province has NO parent, so
            // it must be live from the very first paint - fill it and
            // enable it, and reset only the levels BELOW it (they light up
            // one at a time as each parent is chosen).
            //
            // This used to be `clearBelow(box, 0)`, which also disabled
            // province - and nothing ever re-enabled it, because the only
            // other enable path lived in the stored-village branch below.
            // Result: on a create form all three nav selects stayed
            // disabled with just their placeholder, so village_id could
            // never be chosen at all. Province has no parent to wait for.
            fill(p, rowsFor('p', null), '');
            setEnabled(p, true);
            clearBelow(box, 1);
            return;
        }

        const communeId = (DATA.s || {})[stored];
        if (!communeId) {
            // Village not resolvable from this page's map: keep the stored
            // value posted as-is, but leave the nav empty rather than guess.
            setEnabled(p, false); setEnabled(d, false); setEnabled(c, false);
            return;
        }
        const commRow = (DATA.c || []).find(r => r[0] === communeId);
        const districtId = commRow ? commRow[1] : null;
        const distRow = districtId ? (DATA.d || []).find(r => r[0] === districtId) : null;
        const provinceId = distRow ? distRow[1] : null;

        fill(p, rowsFor('p', null), provinceId);
        setEnabled(p, true);
        fill(d, rowsFor('d', provinceId), districtId);
        setEnabled(d, true);
        fill(c, rowsFor('c', districtId), communeId);
        setEnabled(c, true);

        // The leaf already renders its stored option; fetch its siblings so
        // the user can change their mind without losing the current pick.
        loadVillages(box, communeId, stored);
    }

    function initBox(box) {
        if (box.dataset.geoReady === '1') return;
        box.dataset.geoReady = '1';
        LEVELS.forEach(level => {
            const sel = levelEl(box, level);
            if (!sel || level === 'village') return;
            setEnabled(sel, false);
            sel.addEventListener('change', () => onAncestorChange(box, level));
        });
        restore(box);
    }

    function initAll() {
        readDataset();
        if (!DATA) return;
        byParent = null;
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-geo-cascade]').forEach(initBox);
    }

    window.geoCascade = { init: initAll };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAll);
    // #mc-root is replaced wholesale after a fetch submit; the new DOM has
    // fresh containers, so arm them too.
    document.addEventListener('md:swapped', initAll);
})();

FILE: js/sidebarSwitcher.js

window.SidebarManager = {
    storageKey: 'sidebar_collapsed',

    // 1. Get current collapsed state
    isCollapsed() {
        return localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey) === 'true';
    },

    // 2. Set collapsed state to HTML & localStorage
    setCollapsed(collapsed) {
        localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, collapsed ? 'true' : 'false');
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed', collapsed);
    },

    // 3. Toggle state (mobile: overlay drawer, desktop: collapse rail)
    isMobile() {
        return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767.98px)').matches;
    },

    isMobileOpen() {
        return document.documentElement.classList.contains('mobile-sidebar-open');
    },

    setMobileOpen(open) {
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('mobile-sidebar-open', open);
    },

    toggle() {
        if (this.isMobile()) {
            this.setMobileOpen(!this.isMobileOpen());
        } else {
            this.setCollapsed(!this.isCollapsed());
        }
    },

    // 4. Highlight the current active link based on URL
    updateActiveLink() {
        const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
        const links = document.querySelectorAll('#sidebar a[href]');

        let activeLink = null;

        links.forEach((link) => {
            const linkPath = new URL(link.href, window.location.origin).pathname;

            // Match current route (exact or base match depending on your needs)
            const isActive = currentPath === linkPath || (linkPath !== '/' && currentPath.startsWith(linkPath));

            link.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
            if (isActive) {
                link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
                activeLink = link;

                // If the active item is inside a collapsed accordion/dropdown, expand it
                const parentAccordion = link.closest('.sidebar-group');
                if (parentAccordion) {
                    parentAccordion.classList.add('open');
                }
            } else {
                link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
            }
        });

        return activeLink;
    },

    // 5. Scroll active link into view
    scrollToActive(activeElement) {
        const target = activeElement || document.querySelector('#sidebar a.active');

        // Only scroll if sidebar is expanded and active element exists
        if (target && !this.isCollapsed()) {
            target.scrollIntoView({
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'nearest',
                inline: 'nearest'
            });
        }
    },

    // 6. Position tooltips when collapsed
    positionTooltips() {
        if (!this.isCollapsed()) return;

        const triggers = document.querySelectorAll('#sidebar .group\\\/item, #sidebar .user-card');
        triggers.forEach((trigger) => {
            const tooltip = trigger.querySelector('.sidebar-tooltip');
            if (!tooltip) return;

            trigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
                tooltip.style.left = (rect.right + 8) + 'px';
                tooltip.style.top = (rect.top + rect.height / 2) + 'px';
                tooltip.style.transform = 'translateY(-50%)';
            });
        });
    },

    // 7. Initialization
    init() {
        // Sync state
        this.setCollapsed(this.isCollapsed());

        // Highlight & scroll to active item
        const active = this.updateActiveLink();
        this.scrollToActive(active);

        // Position tooltips
        this.positionTooltips();

        // Bind toggle buttons (any element with data-sidebar-toggle)
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-sidebar-toggle]').forEach((btn) => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.toggle());
        });

        // Close the mobile overlay (backdrop / any element with data-sidebar-close)
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-sidebar-close]').forEach((el) => {
            el.addEventListener('click', () => this.setMobileOpen(false));
        });

        // Escape closes the mobile drawer
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') this.setMobileOpen(false);
        });

        // Leaving the mobile viewport closes the drawer
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (!this.isMobile() && this.isMobileOpen()) this.setMobileOpen(false);
        });
    }
};

// Auto-run on DOM ready
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window.SidebarManager.init());
} else {
    window.SidebarManager.init();
}
